top_stories.title: Exploited SonicWall SSL-VPN flaw lets attackers bypass SAML-enforced MFA (CVE-2026-19868)
top_stories.summary: SonicWall has patched an actively exploited SSL-VPN vulnerability (CVE-2026-19868) in SonicOS that allows attackers with valid credentials to bypass SAML-enforced MFA. No workarounds are available, and SonicWall is urging administrators to apply the patch immediately.

top_stories.title: Threat actors use agentic AI tooling to find and abuse exposed secrets | Microsoft Security Blog
top_stories.summary: Microsoft Threat Intelligence has observed threat actors using the agentic offensive security framework ARTEX to search GitHub for exposed OAuth application secrets. These secrets can be used to compromise OAuth applications and perform authenticated actions, posing a direct threat to identity and access management through credential exposure.

top_stories.title: Introducing AWS account access manager: IAM role flexibility with centralized workforce access
top_stories.summary: AWS is launching "account access manager," a new feature within AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) for managing workforce access to AWS accounts. The feature combines IAM role flexibility with centralized access management for workforce users.

top_stories.title: Phishing-Resistant Isn't Enough; Yubico Takes Aim at Identity-Verification Gap
top_stories.summary: Yubico has launched YubiID, a new service that bridges identity verification with credential enrollment and recovery across existing identity platforms. The announcement also includes a post-quantum YubiKey beta, addressing authentication gaps that persist even with phishing-resistant credentials.

top_stories.title: CISA Flags SonicWall SonicOS MFA Bypass Flaw Amid Reports of Possible Exploitation
top_stories.summary: CISA has added a high-severity SonicWall SonicOS vulnerability (CVE-2026-19868, CVSS 7.1/7.5) to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog following reports of possible real-world exploitation. The flaw has been described as an authentication bypass affecting MFA enforcement in SonicOS.

news.title: What a security leader should tell the CEO about leaked credentials
news.summary: GitGuardian CEO Eric Fourrier discusses how security leaders should communicate with CEOs about leaked credentials, including personal liability and organizational blame culture. The interview covers measuring security progress, handling disclosure deadlines, and credential exposure risks introduced by AI tools and agents.

news.title: SAP Patches Four CVSS 10.0 Flaws, Including Two Enabling Remote Code Execution
news.summary: SAP released patches for four CVSS 10.0 vulnerabilities, including flaws enabling remote code execution without authentication, as part of its monthly Security Patch Day. Three vulnerabilities affect SAP NetWeaver application server and one affects the Web Dispatcher, all exploitable by unauthenticated attackers.

news.title: Hackers Exploit Qubole's Trusted AWS Access to Breach Customer Accounts and Steal Data
news.summary: Attackers exploited trusted AWS credentials used by Qubole's platform to breach multiple customer AWS accounts between October 14-26, stealing secrets and data. The incident highlights risks associated with cross-account access patterns where a vendor's compromised credentials can cascade into customer environment breaches.

news.title: Default 'admin:admin' Server Password Helps Researchers Hack Two Automakers, Unlock and Start Cars
news.summary: Security researchers discovered that ForgeRock/Ping Identity servers used by two automakers' mobile apps had default "admin:admin" credentials, enabling complete takeover of the login systems. The vulnerability allowed attackers to access any customer account and, for connected vehicle owners, remotely unlock doors and start engines.

news.title: Web3Auth Flaw Exploited to Steal Keplr Crypto, Provider Empties Other Wallets for Safety
news.summary: A security flaw in Web3Auth, an authentication provider used by Keplr crypto wallet, was exploited by an attacker to steal cryptocurrency from users who authenticated via Google or Apple accounts. Web3Auth subsequently used the same attack vector to proactively drain other at-risk wallets before the attacker could reach them.

news.title: Week in review: Refrigeration cyberattacks hit European retailers again, Patch Tuesday forecast
news.summary: A weekly security news roundup includes a brief mention of identity policy considerations for AI coding agents in an interview with a KloudStax CTO. The reference to identity is a small component of a broader security news digest covering unrelated topics such as refrigeration cyberattacks and Patch Tuesday.

news.title: Hackers Target OpenSSH SSHole Flaw Within Hours of Disclosure, Gain Root on Honeypot
news.summary: Threat actors began exploiting a newly disclosed OpenSSH vulnerability (CVE-2026-123158, CVSS 8.1), dubbed "SSHole," within hours of its public disclosure, successfully gaining root access on a honeypot. The flaw affects Linux systems running OpenSSH on the musl C library with Pluggable Authentication Modules (PAM) disabled, allowing sign-ins to accounts with no password set.

news.title: Chainalysis Breach Exposes All Users' Credentials, Forces Shutdown of Key Services
news.summary: Chainalysis suffered a breach that exposed names, usernames, password hashes, and live tokens for all users. The company shut down access to its Reactor and Data Solutions services while investigating the incident.

news.title: Govern AI agent access with Okta Cross App Access and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore – Part 2
news.summary: Okta and Amazon Web Services have published a technical guide (Part 2) on governing AI agent access using Okta Cross App Access combined with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. The solution uses Bedrock AgentCore Gateway as a single entry point, with Okta handling authorization grants and Cedar policies binding tools to specific AI agents running on Amazon EKS.

news.title: keycloak v26.8.2
news.summary: Keycloak released version 26.8.2 of its open source identity and access management platform. This is a minor update to the open source IAM solution used for authentication and authorization in modern applications and services.

news.title: Article: Identity as an Architectural Concern: Enterprise IAM Beyond Authentication
news.summary: The article presents enterprise IAM as a core architectural concern rather than a secondary implementation detail. It focuses on how identity design decisions drive data models, service scope, and revocation policies, with particular attention to service account governance.

news.title: OpenSSH Issues Emergency Fix for Flaw Letting Long Passwords Bypass SSH Auth on Alpine Linux
news.summary: OpenSSH released emergency patch version 10.6p2 to address a critical authentication bypass flaw affecting Alpine Linux servers running the standard openssh-server package. The vulnerability allows attackers with network access to bypass SSH authentication on passwordless accounts (such as SSH key-only accounts) by supplying a password between 257 and 1,024 bytes long.

news.title: Fake OpenAI, SpaceX events used to steal Microsoft, Google accounts
news.summary: Hackers are using fake OpenAI, SpaceX, and Anthropic event invitations to conduct phishing attacks targeting Microsoft and Google account credentials. The attacks leverage two phishing-as-a-service platforms to steal both account credentials and authentication sessions, bypassing MFA protections.

news.title: Palo Alto Eyes $500 Million Purchase of Clutch Security
news.summary: Palo Alto Networks is reportedly in talks to acquire Clutch Security for approximately $500 million. Clutch Security is a non-human identity (NHI) security startup, making this acquisition directly relevant to IAM through its focus on securing machine identities, API keys, and service accounts.

news.title: IAM Roles Anywhere now supports automatic certificate revocation checking
news.summary: AWS IAM Roles Anywhere has added support for automatic certificate revocation checking using Certificate Revocation List (CRL) distribution points (CDPs). This feature keeps revocation checks synchronized with the certificate authority, enhancing certificate lifecycle management for workloads using IAM Roles Anywhere.

news.title: ​​​​What’s new in Microsoft Security: November 2026
news.summary: Microsoft released its November 2026 security updates covering AI agent security, least privilege, threat protection, and exposure management. The updates span Microsoft Security products and include changes relevant to identity and access management, particularly around least privilege principles.
